notes: Self-contained variant of Projectpart2.sas: the season_data set is built with an inline DATALINES DATA step instead of PROC IMPORT, so the script runs with no external CSV. The PRINT/MEANS/FREQ/CORR/SGPLOT analysis and the same column set (xG xGA npxG npxGA scored missed wins draws loses pts, plus result/title) are unchanged from the author's original.
